stemMd: A square courtyard has a diagonal of $8\sqrt2$ metres. What is its area?
explanationMd: A square diagonal is side times square root of 2, so the side is 8. Squaring gives area 64.

distractorRationale.c: Squares the diagonal without dividing by 2.
